::: {.bs-page-shell}
::: {.bs-reading-column}
::: {.bs-editorial-lead}
Reusable assignment packages and classroom materials. These include reusable templates from shared course folders and regenerable source packages maintained in this repository.
:::

The library intentionally links to **generic source materials**, not student submissions or student copies. The linked Google Drive materials are shared for public commenting, and the repository packages can be inspected and adapted from source. **General** materials are broadly reusable across subjects and technology courses. **Human Wellness** materials focus on identity, reflection, listening, goal setting, community, and related learning routines.
:::
